comments.text:
Dear BTS,
I don’t even know where to start… my heart feels so full right now. After 4 long years, seeing all of you together again feels like a dream I was waiting for every single day. There were moments when it felt hard, when I missed your music, your laughter, your chaos—but I never stopped believing that this day would come.
And now… it finally has.
I am so, so happy that you all are together again. It’s like a piece of my heart that was missing has come back. Your comeback is not just music for me—it’s comfort, strength, and happiness all at once. You have no idea how much your voices, your words, and your presence mean to me.
I love you sooooo much—more than I can ever properly express. You’ve been with me during my good days and my worst days. You’ve made me smile when I felt like crying, and you’ve given me hope when things felt heavy.
